io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.usageNotes: Search public U.S. senior living community facts and inspect published starting prices, floor plans, review summaries and available government licensing/inspection records. Coverage varies. Published prices are dated observations, not quotes or availability guarantees. Information requests continue on careopenly.com; these MCP tools read public information.
